tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories disputes on disputes.online are filed under, as a flat tree. Use it to find the category_id for a topic before calling search_disputes.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List the categories disputes on disputes.online are filed under, as a flat tree. Use it to find the category_id for a topic before calling search_disputes.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_dispute · Public sink: search_disputes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_dispute · Public sink: search_disputes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_disputes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
